scenario.title: The same recording, replayed at a second institution
scenario.why: Recorded against meridian-cu; replayed against riverstone-fcu, which runs the same vendor product with renamed labels, relocated routes, and a compliance gate meridian does not have. Adapted by a 20-line overlay plus the product profile's terms-gate interrupt -- not a second discovery run.

steps.intent: Open the servicing console entry screen
Enter the operator user ID to begin sign on.
steps.target: textbox "User ID" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (textbox labelled "User ID")

steps.intent: Enter the operator password to complete sign on.
steps.target: password "Password" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (password labelled "Password")

steps.intent: Click the Sign On button to submit operator credentials and sign in to the servicing console.
steps.target: button "Sign On" in OPERATOR SIGN ON (button "Sign On")

steps.intent: Click the Member Servicing menu to begin looking up a member profile.
steps.target: link "Member Servicing" in Meridian Credit Union • Member Servicing Console (link "Member Services" @navFrame)

steps.intent: Enter the member ID to search for member {{input.memberId}}'s profile.
steps.target: textbox "Member ID" in MEMBER SERVICING – INQUIRY (textbox labelled "Account Holder #" @bodyFrame)

steps.intent: Click the Search button to look up member {{input.memberId}}'s profile.
Read the current balance of the REGULAR SHARE SAVINGS account for member {{input.memberId}}.
steps.target: cell "Current Balance" in SHARE / DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS (cell [12345-00 / Current Balance] @bodyFrame)

overlay.description: Riverstone Federal Credit Union runs CorePoint Servicing 4.1.94 -- the same vendor product as Meridian, an older build. It renames three visible labels, reorganises the servicing routes under /servicing/, and mandates an acceptable-use acknowledgement after sign-on. The flow itself is the vendor's and is unchanged, so this is an alias map rather than a second recording.
